thread:
mira: Quick sync request 1) Product proposes a small tenant pilot for per-tenant quantization (3 customers) to cut token costs. 2) Need a cross-team plan for sequencing, telemetry, and rollback SLA. Who takes what?

alex: I9ll lead runtime work: quant profiles, kernel selection heuristics, and tooling to validate numeric drift. Rough estimate: 2 dev sprints + 1 stabilization sprint.

tonY: Infra ops here. We need a separate node pool for quantized workloads (can't co-locate with fp32). Also require feature-flag gating and traffic-shaping controls. ETA: 1.5 sprints to provision + test.

sarah_p: Security asks: sign all model artifacts, add provenance metadata, and run a focused privacy review for tenant-specific variants. KMS integration for model keys is mandatory. I can turn around a checklist in 5 business days.

rachael: Product constraints: start with low-risk routes only, have customer opt-in, and require these launch metrics: >=5% token cost reduction for pilot tenants, median latency delta <10ms, and no regression on the curated correctness eval. Also want a 30-minute rollback SLA.

dan: Platform changes: need per-route config to pin quant profile per tenant + a dynamic fallback route when perf/quality gates trip. I can ship a minimal SDK/route flag in 1 sprint if we lock requirements now.

infra-bot: capacity-snapshot
```
region: us-west-2
available_quant_nodes: 18
available_fp32_nodes: 128
reserved_for_staging: 8
max_quant_mix_pct: 15
```

alex: Suggested rollout plan: (A) infra creates quant node pool and feature flag; (B) runtime implements quant profiles + verification tests; (C) platform exposes pin/fallback and telemetry; (D) internal staging run (48h prewarm); (E) canary: 5% -> 20% -> 100% per route. Security sign-off after B.

rachael: We'll prepare consent language and the eval prompt set. Also propose a weekly adoption dashboard: tokens_quantized_pct per tenant and per-route.

Tony: Ops note: prewarming is critical. Quant nodes show higher cold-start p99; plan a 48-hour prewarm with synthetic traffic. Also we need a playbook for emergency rollback (commands + runbook).

alex: I9ll add an automated perf gate to the rollout: if P99 latency increases >20% or correctness fail detected, auto-fail canary and trigger rollback. Add telemetry event names: quant.canary.p99, quant.canary.quality_fail, quant.rollbacks.triggered.

dan: I'll emit those telemetry events and add a short schema for dashboarding. Will post the route-config proto this afternoon.

sarah_p: I'll validate artifact signing flow and KMS access for the pilot tenants. Also document allowed data categories for pilot prompts.

mira: Owners: Alex (runtime), Tony (infra/ops), Dan (platform), Sarah (security), Rachael (product). Blockers: infra pool provisioning, telemetry hooks, and signed artifact delivery.

rachael: Next sync Thursday 11am PT for canary window sign-off. I'll notify pilot customers and collect consent.

alex: I9ll publish a short "rollout playbook" with exact canary steps, monitoring queries, and rollback shell commands before Thursday. Example rollback: `curl -X POST /admin/route/{route}/pin -d '{"profile":"fp32"}' --auth admin`

mira: Perfect, keep updates here. Short notes only please. :pray:
